scope.description: Webshop platforms that Dutch wholesalers, technical wholesalers, e-tailers and specialist retailers consider instead of Highbiza.
scope.inclusionLogic: Included: platforms Highbiza itself compares against (Magento/Adobe Commerce, WooCommerce, Shopify), Dutch B2B commerce specialists (Sana Commerce, Propeller) and Dutch SaaS webshop builders with B2B options (CCV Shop, Lightspeed). Excluded: implementation agencies and Katapull siblings. Logic4's built-in webshop overlaps with Highbiza within the group and is noted, not listed.
scope.notes: Business stats are given only where an official primary source was found; most competitors are private and publish no comparable figures. Highbiza publishes no revenue.

players.name: Shopify
players.description: SaaS commerce platform with B2B features in Shopify Plus; Highbiza describes it as user-friendly but limited in customisation and dependent on its app store.

businessStats.sourceTitle: Shopify Inc. Form 10-K for fiscal year 2025

players.name: Adobe Commerce (Magento)
players.description: Open-source Magento and its commercial Adobe Commerce edition; the platform many Highbiza customers leave, described by Highbiza as powerful but heavy and maintenance-intensive.

players.name: WooCommerce
players.description: WordPress e-commerce plug-in; Highbiza argues dependence on many plug-ins creates risk and maintenance.

players.name: Sana Commerce
players.description: ERP-integrated B2B e-commerce for manufacturers and distributors on SAP and Microsoft Dynamics; competes for ERP-centric wholesalers.

players.name: Propeller
players.description: Composable B2B commerce cloud with customer-specific catalogues and pricing, quotes and AI sales agents; targets mid-market wholesalers and manufacturers.

players.name: CCV Shop
players.description: Dutch SaaS webshop builder with templates, B2B and retail options and a free trial; competes at the Launch/Core end.

players.name: Lightspeed
players.description: Retail POS with integrated eCom; competes for retailers and jewellers who want shop and store in one, where Katapull answers with Vendit plus Highbiza.
